name: South Carolina

labor.name: South Carolina Department of Employment and Workforce

corpReport.title: File Annual Report and Corporate License Fee (with SCDOR)
corpReport.deadline: With the corporate income tax return (April 15)

feeDetail.note: of capital stock and paid-in surplus, plus $15

penalty.note: Corporate tax return late-filing penalty is 5% of unpaid tax per month, capped at 25%; late license-fee payments also have a 0.5% monthly penalty capped at 25%.
South Carolina publishes no separate late monetary penalty for LLP renewal; failure to maintain required filings can affect authority.

entityTax: Corporate income tax and corporate license fee

permitFee.note: Non-refundable retail license fee for each business location.

penalty.note: 5% of the tax for each month or fraction the return is late, up to 25%; late payment adds 0.5% a month, also up to 25%.

unemployment.note: 10% of the unemployment tax owed for a late wage report, with a $25 minimum and a $1,000 maximum, plus interest from the day after the due date.

newHire.note: No current official penalty amount for a late new hire report was found; secondary sources conflict or give only the federal $25 and $500 ceilings.

laborPosters.note: No penalty amount specific to the required workplace notices was found in the state's labor and workers' compensation sources.

workersComp.note: $1 per employee but not less than $10 nor more than $100 for each day of refusal or neglect (S.C. Code 42-5-40).

local.title: Municipal or county business license
local.authority: City or county business license office
local.description: Every South Carolina business needs a local business license under the Business License Tax Standardization Act.
